title: Breakie Burgers
desc: Freezer breakfast burgers: English muffin, pork and beef patty, cheese, homemade pickles and hot sauce.

portions.J: 1 burger with a double lean patty (160 g raw)
portions.P: 1 burger with a single patty (80 g raw)

ingredients.name: pork and beef mince (80 g patties)

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Shape the mince into 80 g patties, a little wider than the muffins. Season.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Cook in a hot pan or on the barbecue about 3 to 4 minutes a side until cooked through.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Muffin, patty (two for Jaidyn's), cheese slice, pickles and hot sauce.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Cool, wrap each burger and freeze. Microwave from frozen about 90 seconds, then toast if you like.

notes: Add an egg for about 70 kcal and 6 g protein.
